subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how visual elements (charts, images, captions) contribute to an informational text's meaning
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a text passage with and without an accompanying chart/image and discusses what the visual adds
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a visual element to the specific point it helps clarify or support
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a given visual element contributes to an informational text's overall meaning

misconception_flags: describes what a visual shows without explaining what it adds to or clarifies about the text's argument

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
